_note: Confirmatory E1 (docs/preregistration-draft.md; .steering/20261112-paper-write/decisions.md 判断 1-43; design .steering/20261112-e1-prereg-impl/design.md and .steering/20261113-prereg-v2/design.md). To be frozen with the preregistration. Paraphrases 0-3 are those of experiments/20261111-llm-dry-run; 4-7 are new (same style axes: politeness, urgency, verbosity, format) and were confirmed as drafted in 判断 14 (experiments/20261113-e1-colab-dryrun). k0n: the K0n control (K0 plus a neutral text as long as the K1 and K2 sentences; 判断 20) runs at this lambda and D only, default paraphrases. alpha_one_sided: the level of the Holm-adjusted one-sided p of H1 and H2 (判断 17); the final H1 / H2 decision is made by scripts/e2_summarise.py --e1. 判断 25・26: the primary V is the balanced 1/2 TPR + 1/2 TNR (the pi-weighted V is a secondary under pi_weighted); an action is p > tau (0.5 exactly is not an action). delta_E1 = 0.03 applies to the balanced dV (判断 27: kept; about 1.5 persons' action at 24+24, about 2.4 at 40+40); it is not part of the H1 decision (判断 22). One-sided bootstrap p = (b + 1) / (B + 1) (判断 32); missing reads over 10% trigger the H1 sensitivity analysis (判断 31); the sensitivity analysis also carries the fills adverse to H1 (fill_adverse, 判断 38). 判断 35: H1_K2_minus_K0 also carries dV_opt (the best rule, act iff p > pi) and dAUC as secondaries fixed in advance. 判断 36: the E1 summary is made once, after every stage has finished with exit code 0; scripts/e2_summarise.py --e1 stops unless completeness.complete is true. 判断 39: the H1 p that enters Holm is H1_K2_minus_K0.p_one_sided_permutation (sign-flip permutation test on the per-person contributions, n_flips = bootstrap.n); the bootstrap p_one_sided is reported only. 判断 40: n_A = n_not_A = 40 (was 24; the permutation test's power in the preliminary-like scenario, experiments/20261113-e1-power-permutation-n). 判断 41: the missing-read sensitivity analysis and the secondary contrasts also carry the sign-flip permutation p (p_one_sided_permutation; round 3 A1, A10), beside the bootstrap p, with no change to any decision rule; the model digests and the Ollama version are fixed in run.sh at the freeze and checked by e1_run.py before any model call (round 3 A7). 判断 42: run.sh runs only the 6 frozen test modules and its git checks cover exactly the frozen set. 判断 43: upstream documents follow the draft (no effect on this file). num_ctx 8192 を明示（2026-11-14。予備は既定値で、prompt＋生成 > 4096 の読みがあった）. 判断 44 (2026-11-14): H0d = manipulation check of K on the t0 reads at h0d.lambda (K3 picks up the person's D2 facts: mean of p0(K3) - p0(K2) higher for persons with any D2 display, 95% lower bound > 0, each group >= min_group persons; K1 and K2 stay at the stated overall rate: 90% interval of mean(p0 - rate) inside +-margin_rate); H1_scope is full only if H0b, H0c and H0d are all supported.
